name: outlook
description: Read and draft Microsoft Outlook mail + read calendar via Microsoft Graph as the signed-in user. Delegated permissions; mail writes are draft-only (no send tool, no Mail.Send scope). Inbound mail less than 30 minutes old is filtered out as a safety measure against one-time passwords leaking into the agent context.

clientId.description: Override the embedded Entra app id.

tokenCachePath.description: Path to the MSAL token cache. Defaults to <agentDir>/outlook-tokens.json on a multi-agent OpenClaw gateway (per-agent isolation), or ~/.outlook-plugin/tokens.json when no agent context is available. Override only when you need explicit control.

account.description: UPN to use when multiple accounts are cached. Required for multi-account hosts.

oauthRedirectUri.description: Public HTTPS redirect URI for the browser Authorization-Code (PKCE) sign-in flow, e.g. https://<gateway>.<tailnet>.ts.net/outlook/auth-callback. When set, outlook_auth_login returns a sign-in URL instead of a device code (required where Conditional Access blocks device-code flow). Must exactly match a redirect URI registered in the Entra app. Leave unset to keep the device-code flow.
